name: thrm_breeder_wall
description: SHLD-sheathed, COAL-lined column with a CLNE(THRM) breeder every N rows -- keeps a thermite fuel wall from depleting, the same self-breeding technique breeder_liner applies to DEUT.
why: 214245 ('Advanced Thermite Reactor') is the only save in the harvest to use THRM as a genuinely breedable, pipeable fuel rather than a one-shot ignition charge: a 477-cell CLNE(THRM) breeder wall at (555,229)-(595,325) sits inside SHLD (self-repairing sheath) and COAL (194 particles, moderator/liner), with PRTI (1006) moving bred thermite onward and FILT (322) filtering it. breeder_liner already covers the DEUT case; this is the THRM equivalent since thermite's ignition behaviour (burns hot, doesn't chain-react like DEUT) makes it a distinct fuel-safety case worth its own module.
source: save 214245, breeder column (555,229)-(595,325); composition THRM=2223 PRTI=1006 CLNE=477 FILT=322 COAL=194 SHLD=40
